name: desktop-lyrics
description: Universal desktop synced lyrics overlay for Windows

scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win portable --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npx electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.json

author: Diwas Dhakal (https://github.com/Diwasdh)
